name: Hostinger VPS
since_note: Company founded 2004 as Hosting Media (Hostinger about page, Wikipedia); VPS launch year not published.
notes: Prices are per month on a 24-month prepaid term (KVM 2 = $210.96 upfront) and renew higher ($14.99). KVM 1 is $6.49, renews $11.99. One-click n8n template runs in Docker.

name: Google Cloud
free_plan_limits: $300 credit for 90 days, plus one free e2-micro VM and 2M Cloud Run requests a month
notes: No fixed plan, so a monthly cost is not stated. Free VM works only in 3 US regions. Docker via Cloud Run and Compute Engine; static and database use assumed from standard products, not read on pages.

name: Vercel
free_plan_limits: Hobby: 1 seat, 100 GB transfer, 1M function calls a month; no extra usage can be bought
usage_note: $20 per developer seat includes $20 of usage credit, then pay as you go
since_note: Founded 2015 as ZEIT, renamed Vercel April 2020 (Wikipedia).
notes: Not built for always-on servers like n8n. No managed database on the pricing page; databases come via Marketplace integrations. Commercial use on Hobby not checked.

name: Railway
free_plan_limits: $1 of usage a month, 1 vCPU / 0.5 GB per service; new accounts get $5 trial credit for 30 days
usage_note: About $10 per GB of RAM-month and $20 per vCPU-month
best_for: Quick app and n8n deploys, usage billed
notes: Hobby $5 includes $5 usage; Pro $20 per workspace includes $20 usage and unlimited seats. Real bill grows with usage. Database and Docker use not stated on the pricing page.

name: AWS
free_plan_limits: $100 credit, up to $200 more for trying services; free plan closes after 6 months
notes: No fixed plan, so monthly cost is not stated. Free plan has no surprise bills; 30+ services stay free within limits. Docker, static and database use rely on standard AWS services, not read on this page.

name: Netlify
free_plan_limits: 300 credits a month (a production deploy costs 15 credits)
usage_note: Bandwidth 20 credits per GB; extra 1,500 credits cost $10 on Pro
best_for: Static sites and simple web apps
notes: Personal $9 gets 1,000 credits; Pro $20 is flat for unlimited members with 3,000 credits. Credits can run out. Includes Netlify Database per pricing page.

name: Render
free_plan_limits: Hobby workspace is $0; static sites free, bandwidth and build minutes capped
usage_note: Each paid service costs extra; Starter instance from $7 a month for 512 MB
notes: Pro workspace is $25 flat with no seat fees (replaced the old $19 per member). Pricing page would not load; numbers are from Render's changelog and articles. $32 = Pro + one $7 Starter instance.

name: Coolify
free_plan_limits: Self-hosted is free; you pay for your own server
usage_note: $5 covers 2 servers; each extra server is $3
best_for: Your own Vercel-style host on a cheap VPS
notes: Apache-2.0 open source. Cloud only runs the dashboard; you still pay for a server (for example a VPS). Self-hosted and Cloud have the same features. Feature details from Coolify's comparison pages.

name: DigitalOcean
free_plan_limits: App Platform: 3 static-site apps free, 1 GiB transfer each; promo credits vary
usage_note: Extra outbound transfer $0.02 per GiB on App Platform
best_for: Simple virtual servers with clear prices
notes: $4 Droplet has only 512 MiB RAM; n8n needs more, so plan on a bigger one. App Platform containers start at $5. Dev database $7 (PostgreSQL only). One-click n8n is from DigitalOcean's marketplace, not read on these pages.

name: Modal
free_plan_limits: Starter: $0 base fee with $30 of free credits a month
usage_note: Per second: CPU $0.0000131 per core, memory $0.00000222 per GiB, GPUs from $0.000164 (T4)
best_for: Running AI code on GPUs by the second
notes: Team plan is $250 a month with $100 credits. Starter has no base fee, so a small business pays only for compute used. Not a place for always-on n8n.
